properties.displayName: UAV S110 - Gimbal/Payload Control Hijacking (Unauthorized Sensor Pointing)
properties.description: UAVPayloadCtrl_CL의 gimbal_point/payload_arm/sensor_slew 명령에서 Operator가 Watchlist(Approved_Operators_List)에 없거나 Operator-UAVId 조합이 Watchlist(Operator_UAV_Binding_List)의 유효 바인딩에 없는 경우 탐지. 비인가 주체가 짐벌/페이로드 지향 명령을 탈취해 센서 지향을 조작하는 행위. MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0831 / EMB3D 통제신호조작
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let ApprovedOps = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Operators_List') | project OperatorId;
let ValidBindings = _GetWatchlist('Operator_UAV_Binding_List') | project OperatorId, AllowedUAVId;
UAVPayloadCtrl_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventType in ('gimbal_point', 'payload_arm', 'sensor_slew')
| extend isUnknownOp = Operator !in (ApprovedOps)
| join kind=leftouter (ValidBindings) on $left.Operator == $right.OperatorId, $left.UAVId == $right.AllowedUAVId
| extend isUnboundUAV = isnull(OperatorId)
| where isUnknownOp or isUnboundUAV
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isUnknownOp, strcat('페이로드지향_비인가_Operator_', Operator),
    strcat('페이로드지향_UAV바인딩_불일치_', Operator, '_', UAVId))
| extend Severity = 'Medium'
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, Operator, EventType, PayloadCommand, TargetLat, TargetLon, CommandSource, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S110 - Gimbal/Payload Control Hijacking (Unauthorized Sensor Pointing) - {{Operator}}
